content:
BUILT CoLAB supports the “Sustainable and Digital Building” webinar organized by the Polytechnic Institute of Leiria.

This event takes place on July 14 and aims to create a discussion forum, addressing different topics with the contribution of some of the experts in the field.

The topics to be discussed are the challenges in improving the efficiency of the construction sector, including “green construction” throughout the life cycle, from planning to design, construction, operation, maintenance, renovation and demolition, as well as digital transition.

You can consult complete information, program, and speakers, as well as register (free) here.
